sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 360. Success value 100. 4x physical damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Constriction. The next Ability used will change from targeting all to a single target (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all enemies. Removes 40 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% elevation for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 30% concentration for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Siege for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; Applies Vital Strike (10% chance to increase damage dealt by 50%). Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Heartless Collapse (increases Ability Powerof damage taken by 30, increases Ability Power of damage taken while in Break by 30, and increases Ability Power of damage taken from critical hits by 30) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000

[White Swim Ring] Ren or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
